nodes.description: Owned.owner: privileged address set from msg.sender at construction; read by the onlyOwner guard.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner used in the two-step ownership transfer handshake.
dCHF.symbol token ticker metadata.
dCHF.name token name metadata.
dCHF.decimals token precision metadata.
dCHF._totalSupply total minted amount (1500000).
dCHF.balances mapping of holder balances, mutated by transfer/transferFrom.
dCHF.allowed nested mapping of ERC20 allowances.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for balances, allowances, ownership checks.
SafeMath.safeAdd: unchecked a+b followed by require(c >= a) overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeSub: require(b <= a) then unchecked a-b.
SafeMath.safeMul: unchecked a*b followed by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv: require(b > 0) then a / b.
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership: onlyOwner sets newOwner (no zero-address check).
Owned.acceptOwnership: newOwner must call to finalize transfer and emit OwnershipTransferred.
dCHF constructor: sets metadata, mints 1500000 to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
dCHF.totalSupply: returns raw _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with unchecked subtraction.
dCHF.balanceOf: returns balances[tokenOwner].
dCHF.transfer: safeSub from msg.sender, safeAdd to 'to', emits Transfer.
dCHF.approve: overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no race protection.
dCHF.transferFrom: safeSub from 'from' balance and allowance, safeAdd to 'to'.
dCHF.allowance: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
dCHF.approveAndCall: sets allowance then invokes spender contract receiveApproval -> external call before state finalisation semantics.
dCHF payable fallback: immediately reverts to reject ETH.
dCHF.transferAnyERC20Token: onlyOwner external call to arbitrary token contract transferring tokens to owner.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply (raw arithmetic, no SafeMath).
Raw uint addition c = a + b inside safeAdd prior to the overflow require.
Raw uint subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub.
Raw uint multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul prior to the division check.
External call to attacker-supplied spender contract via ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval before approveAndCall returns (reentrancy surface).
External call to arbitrary tokenAddress contract ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) executed as owner.

edges.reason: safeAdd operand a feeds the unchecked addition.
safeAdd operand b feeds the unchecked addition.
safeSub minuend a flows into c = a - b.
safeSub subtrahend b gates require(b <= a) and the subtraction.
safeMul operand a flows into c = a * b and the division check.
safeMul operand b flows into c = a * b.
safeDiv dividend a flows into c = a / b.
safeDiv divisor b gates require(b > 0).
_newOwner is written into newOwner by the onlyOwner function.
transfer recipient 'to' receives safeAdd credit into balances.
transfer amount 'tokens' is debited/credited via SafeMath.
approve spender indexes the allowed mapping.
approve tokens value is stored into the allowance slot.
transferFrom debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom credits balances[to].
transferFrom amount drives both SafeMath operations.
balanceOf lookup key tokenOwner indexes balances.
allowance owner key indexes allowed.
allowance spender key indexes allowed.
spender is the attacker-controlled external contract invoked in approveAndCall.
tokens is stored in allowed and forwarded to receiveApproval.
arbitrary data is forwarded to the external spender contract call.
tokenAddress selects the arbitrary contract invoked in transferAnyERC20Token.
tokens amount is passed to the arbitrary external transfer call.
safeAdd writes the result into local c.
safeSub writes the result into local c.
safeMul writes the result into local c.
safeDiv writes the result into local c.
totalSupply returns the raw, unchecked subtraction result.
safeAdd performs the raw a + b addition.
safeSub performs the raw a - b subtraction.
safeMul performs the raw a * b multiplication.
approveAndCall hands control to the external spender contract.
transferAnyERC20Token hands control to an arbitrary external token contract.
Owned constructor assigns privileged owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership proceeds.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom debits the caller's allowance allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
msg.sender is forwarded as the 'from' argument of the untrusted receiveApproval callback.
onlyOwner gate compares msg.sender with owner before the external transfer.
Constructor stores msg.sender into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes _newOwner into newOwner without validation.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to authorize the caller.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner.
acceptOwnership emits OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner).
onlyOwner reads owner as the authorization value.
transferAnyERC20Token sends recovered tokens to the owner address.

balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer reads and writes balances for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes balances for from and to.
transfer mutates balances via safeSub/safeAdd.
transferFrom mutates balances via safeSub/safeAdd.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping.
approve stores tokens into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall stores tokens into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
The spender contract's receiveApproval is invoked while approveAndCall is still executing.
The malicious spender can re-enter transfer during the external callback.
The malicious spender can re-enter transferFrom during the external callback.
Execution is delegated to an untrusted ERC20 contract that may call back.
The arbitrary token contract can re-enter transfer while transferAnyERC20Token holds owner privileges.
The arbitrary token contract can re-enter transferFrom while transferAnyERC20Token holds owner privileges.

Parameter a of safeMul is only meaningful inside the safeMul computation.

'to' exists solely as the transfer recipient argument.
'tokens' exists solely as the transfer amount argument.
spender exists solely as the approve allowance key.
tokens exists solely as the approve allowance value.
'from' exists solely as the transferFrom debited account.
